nodes.label: light-dark() token needs a plain fallback declared before the call
nodes.norm_label: light-dark() token needs a plain fallback declared before the call
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-terminal-log-intelligence/2026-10-02 - t2-color-tokens-dark-mode [ses_f05fd50c6ffe3pH7j0O8oqbxAK].md:L49] Each must be a `light-dark(<light>, <dark>)` call, with a plain fallback value declared before it so an old browser without light-dark() still gets a sane colour.
nodes.summary: Every colour token in the dashboard stylesheet is written twice in the :root block: a plain value first, then the light-dark() call. The plain declaration is what an engine without light-dark() keeps, so the token still resolves to a sane colour there instead of falling back to the initial value.

nodes.label: Colours in a file you do not own are fixed by defining the palette as custom properties
nodes.norm_label: colours in a file you do not own are fixed by defining the palette as custom properties
rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-terminal-log-intelligence/2026-10-02 - t2-color-tokens-dark-mode [ses_f05fd50c6ffe3pH7j0O8oqbxAK].md:L43] THE KEY CONSTRAINT: you can only change style.css, but two of those failures (#0550ae, #4d2d00) live in the donut palette inside app.js, which you do not own. Solve this WITHOUT editing app.js: define the full 8-slot categorical palette as CSS custom properties (for example --cat-1 through --cat-8), pick all eight values so that every slot reaches 3:1 or better against --bg in BOTH modes, and document in your report the exact token names and values that the app.js owner (subagent D, Task T4) must reference. Values must be readable in dark mode; a very dark brown or navy is not acceptable just because it was in the old palette. Preserve the GitHub Primer identity of the accent and danger colours; only their lightness may change where contrast requires it.

[05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-terminal-log-intelligence/2026-10-02 - t2-color-tokens-dark-mode [ses_f05fd50c6ffe3pH7j0O8oqbxAK].md:L6225] T4 must replace the literal array at `app.js:207` with `var(--cat-N)`. Index order is the donut slice order.
nodes.summary: Two of the measured WCAG failures lived in the 8-slot donut palette inside app.js, a file owned by a different subagent. The fix stays entirely in style.css: the palette becomes --cat-1 through --cat-8, and the report hands the app.js owner the exact token names and slot order to substitute for the literal array.

nodes.label: A zero-hex-literal rule is only satisfiable once the token values themselves are rgb()
nodes.norm_label: a zero-hex-literal rule is only satisfiable once the token values themselves are rgb()
rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-terminal-log-intelligence/2026-10-02 - t2-color-tokens-dark-mode [ses_f05fd50c6ffe3pH7j0O8oqbxAK].md:L5024] The zero-hex assertion is only satisfiable if token values themselves avoid6-digit hex. Converting the token values to `rgb()` notation so the assertion is meaningful (any hex literal becomes a duplication signal).

[05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-terminal-log-intelligence/2026-10-02 - t2-color-tokens-dark-mode [ses_f05fd50c6ffe3pH7j0O8oqbxAK].md:L6221] Two of my own assertions failed *after* implementation and caught real problems, not just noise: the zero-hex rule collided with hex token values (fixed by switching token values to `rgb()` notation so any hex becomes a duplication signal), and the legend test read only the first rule block while the swatches are split across five.
nodes.summary: The test that forbids bare 6-digit hex literals in the stylesheet also matches the hex literals that ARE the token values, so the rule could not pass as written. Converting every token value to rgb() notation makes the assertion mean what it says: from then on any hex literal in the file is a re-introduced duplication.

nodes.label: getComputedStyle on a custom property returns the unresolved token sequence, not the used colour
nodes.norm_label: getcomputedstyle on a custom property returns the unresolved token sequence, not the used colour
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-terminal-log-intelligence/2026-10-02 - t2-color-tokens-dark-mode [ses_f05fd50c6ffe3pH7j0O8oqbxAK].md:L6262] One caveat worth flagging for your audit: `getComputedStyle` on a custom property returns the unresolved `light-dark(...)` token sequence, which is normal CSS behaviour, so the token values only become observable at paint time. A future test that asserts on computed custom properties directly would be testing the wrong layer.
nodes.summary: Reading a custom property through getComputedStyle hands back the literal light-dark(...) token sequence, because that is what a custom property stores. The used colour only exists at paint time, so a future test asserting on computed custom properties would be reading the wrong layer and would pass regardless of contrast.

nodes.label: Contrast is verified by sampling painted pixels in a real engine, not by trusting the test
nodes.norm_label: contrast is verified by sampling painted pixels in a real engine, not by trusting the test
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-terminal-log-intelligence/2026-10-02 - t2-color-tokens-dark-mode [ses_f05fd50c6ffe3pH7j0O8oqbxAK].md:L6257] I did not trust the test alone. I rendered `style.css` in real Firefox headless in both light and a `ui.systemUsesDarkTheme=1` profile and sampled painted pixels:
nodes.summary: After the token layer went green, the stylesheet was still rendered in headless Firefox in both a light and a ui.systemUsesDarkTheme=1 profile and the painted pixels sampled. That is what proved light-dark() and the fallback layering work in an engine rather than only in the parser that read the file.

nodes.label: The heat scale ramp runs dark-to-light in opposite directions per mode so one ink colour works
nodes.norm_label: the heat scale ramp runs dark-to-light in opposite directions per mode so one ink colour works
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar-proyek-terminal-log-intelligence/2026-10-02 - t2-color-tokens-dark-mode [ses_f05fd50c6ffe3pH7j0O8oqbxAK].md:L2759] To be safe in both modes: make the ramp in light mode all fairly dark (white ink works), and in dark mode all fairly light (dark ink works). That's simplest and safe.
nodes.summary: Instead of choosing an ink colour per cell, the ramp is built so the light-mode cells are all dark enough for white ink and the dark-mode cells are all light enough for dark ink. One --cell-ink token then clears 4.5:1 on every step of the ramp in both modes.

nodes.label: KeePassXC-Browser cannot connect until the native messaging host manifest exists
nodes.norm_label: keepassxc-browser cannot connect until the native messaging host manifest exists
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - debugging-passkey-creation-failure [ses_f31c70ac6ffeL39IT1sFhjBsBX].md:L3425] Sudah saya buatkan jembatan yang hilang (`~/.mozilla/native-messaging-hosts/org.keepassxc.keepassxc_browser.json` → `keepassxc-proxy`). Itu penyebab "Tidak dapat terhubung".
nodes.summary: The extension reported it could not connect even though KeePassXC's own config already allowed passkeys. The missing piece was ~/.mozilla/native-messaging-hosts/org.keepassxc.keepassxc_browser.json pointing at keepassxc-proxy; without that manifest Firefox has no native host to hand WebAuthn requests to.

nodes.label: KeePassXC-Browser ships passkeys interception off, so requests fall through to the Firefox dialog
nodes.norm_label: keepassxc-browser ships passkeys interception off, so requests fall through to the firefox dialog
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - debugging-passkey-creation-failure [ses_f31c70ac6ffeL39IT1sFhjBsBX].md:L4501] Dan `content/passkeys-inject.js:117`: pencegatan WebAuthn **hanya aktif kalau `settings.passkeys` true**. Jadi selama ini request lewat ke dialog bawaan Firefox (yang gagal), KeePassXC tidak pernah dilibatkan — makanya tidak ada popup.
nodes.summary: Found in the extension source: the interception hook only runs when settings.passkeys is true, and that setting defaults to false. With it off the browser handled WebAuthn itself, so the built-in Creating passkey dialog appeared and KeePassXC was never involved.

nodes.label: accounts.firefox.com CSP omits moz-extension:, which blocks password-manager passkey injection
nodes.norm_label: accounts.firefox.com csp omits moz-extension:, which blocks password-manager passkey injection
rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - debugging-passkey-creation-failure [ses_f31c70ac6ffeL39IT1sFhjBsBX].md:L5125] Tidak ada `moz-extension:` → script injeksi KeePassXC-Browser (`content/passkeys.js`) **diblokir CSP** di `accounts.firefox.com`. Ekstensi tidak pernah bisa mencegat WebAuthn di halaman itu, makanya selalu jatuh ke dialog native yang gagal. Cek console pasti ada baris CSP memblokir `moz-extension://...`.
nodes.summary: The page's own Content-Security-Policy is script-src 'self' https://cdn.accounts.firefox.com, with no moz-extension: source. The script KeePassXC-Browser injects to intercept WebAuthn is therefore blocked by the browser, and the page's own policy is what closes that path, not any local setting.

nodes.label: Firefox on Linux cannot create native passkeys even with a FIDO2 key present
nodes.norm_label: firefox on linux cannot create native passkeys even with a fido2 key present
rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - debugging-passkey-creation-failure [ses_f31c70ac6ffeL39IT1sFhjBsBX].md:L6232] | Bikin passkey di YubiKey | **tidak bisa** | bisa (dengan Bitwarden) |

[05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - debugging-passkey-creation-failure [ses_f31c70ac6ffeL39IT1sFhjBsBX].md:L6236] Jadi Firefox Linux memang lumpuh untuk bikin passkey native — bukan salah mesinmu.
nodes.summary: A vendor compatibility table documents that Firefox on Linux can log in with a YubiKey but cannot create a passkey on one, while Chrome and Brave can. So the failure to register on this machine is a browser limitation rather than a hardware or configuration fault.

nodes.label: Turning CSP off to register a passkey only moves the failure from creating to logging in
nodes.norm_label: turning csp off to register a passkey only moves the failure from creating to logging in
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - debugging-passkey-creation-failure [ses_f31c70ac6ffeL39IT1sFhjBsBX].md:L6289] registrasi cuma sekali, tapi tiap **login** pakai passkey itu di halaman Mozilla kena tembok CSP yang sama. Jadi no. 3 cuma memindahkan kegagalan dari "bikin" ke "pakai".
nodes.summary: Disabling security.csp.enable does let the extension inject and the passkey register, but registration happens once while every later login hits the same policy on the same page. The workaround relocates the failure instead of removing it, so it was rejected in favour of a hardware key that bypasses the page policy entirely.

nodes.label: NumLock off makes a numeric password entered on the numpad arrive as non-digits
nodes.norm_label: numlock off makes a numeric password entered on the numpad arrive as non-digits
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - debugging-passkey-creation-failure [ses_f31c70ac6ffeL39IT1sFhjBsBX].md:L2249] **NumLock OFF** (`brightness: 0`). Kalau ketik `790602` via numpad (blok angka kanan), yang masuk bukan angka → `sudo` gagal terus.
nodes.summary: sudo rejected a correct numeric password repeatedly even though su worked. The keyboard's brightness indicator was 0, meaning NumLock was off, so the numpad block typed letters instead of digits and every attempt was counted as a failure.

nodes.label: systemd-resolved rejects DNSOverTLS=strict on this machine, so opportunistic yes is used instead
nodes.norm_label: systemd-resolved rejects dnsovertls=strict on this machine, so opportunistic yes is used instead
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - debugging-passkey-creation-failure [ses_f31c70ac6ffeL39IT1sFhjBsBX].md:L8682] systemd di sini menolak `strict` (`Invalid argument`), jadi dipakai `yes` (oportunistik — tetap terenkripsi di jaringanmu; fallback plaintext hanya jika port 853 diblokir).
nodes.summary: Configuring DNS over TLS system-wide, strict mode was rejected with Invalid argument, so the opportunistic setting was used. Traffic is still encrypted on the local network; only a blocked port 853 would fall back to plaintext.

nodes.label: The taskbar layout shift was the preview thumbnail popup, not the animation settings
nodes.norm_label: the taskbar layout shift was the preview thumbnail popup, not the animation settings
nodes.rationale: [05 - Conversations/home-belajarcarabelajar/2026-09-23 - debugging-passkey-creation-failure [ses_f31c70ac6ffeL39IT1sFhjBsBX].md:L13935] yang "naik" itu **popup preview thumbnail** di atas tombol taskbar (kotak `Dolphin Beranda` + tombol X). Muncul tiap hover/klik tombol.
nodes.summary: After disabling every animation effect and locking the panel to one row, geometry measurements and pixel diffs across states were all identical, so the remaining movement was not an effect at all. Reading a frame of the user's own screen recording identified the thumbnail preview that pops above a taskbar button on hover; turning showToolTips off removed it.
